bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 test -f /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs
docker exec -e VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_ENTRY_APPLY=enabled deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs >/tmp/video-two-topic-apply.out 2>/tmp/video-two-topic-apply.err
grep -q 'VIDEO_ENTRY_FIXED' /tmp/video-two-topic-apply.out
test "$(grep -c 'VIDEO_ENTRY_FIXED' /tmp/video-two-topic-apply.out)" -eq 2
echo VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_POST_AND_PIN=PASS
